==Overview==
This category collects [[ritual|rituals]] that are relevant to [[war]], and the military campaign. Most are [[enchantment|enchantments]] that target either an [[Army|Imperial army]] or a [[military unit]] [[Resource#Personal_Resource|personal resource]]. although there are also several [[curse|curses]] that have implications for armies and [[Navy|navies]].

All these rituals are part of either [[Formulaic_ritual#Imperial_Lore_and_the_Ritual_List|Imperial lore]] or [[Urizen_magical_traditions#Urizen_Lore|Urizen lore]].
